description: Vision fallback: click the point (x, y in CSS pixels from the viewport origin) you picked from alterlab_task_vision_capture, then verify the result. Pass expect.text for text that should appear, or leave it to check that the page changed. The click is treated as a submit and asks for approval, unless your previous vision click was observed to be plain navigation. Each use is audited, flags the recipe for repair and counts toward a per-run cap, and past the cap it asks again. The result reports the class the click turned out to be. On awaiting_user show the pending request, call alterlab_task_answer, then retry unchanged.

expect.description: Read-back check: {"text": "text shown after the click"} or {"changed": true}. Default {"changed": true}

recipe.description: Recipe the click belongs to, for standing permissions

selector.description: Region the point must fall inside; same value passed to capture

x.description: Horizontal target in CSS pixels from the viewport origin

y.description: Vertical target in CSS pixels from the viewport origin

name: alterlab_task_vision_act
title: Browser Task Click By Coordinates
